cases.name: defaults
cases.why: the shipped configuration is one nothing objects to

issues.message: Cruise design point (126 m/s EAS at Mach 0.84 / 11,887 m) exceeds the design dive speed VD (100 m/s EAS): the aircraft would cruise outside its own structural flight envelope.

cases.name: cruise_past_dive_speed
cases.why: the cruise design point sits outside the V-n envelope entirely: an error, which blocks the run

issues.message: Cruise design point (126 m/s EAS) is above VC (104 m/s EAS = VD/1.25): the aircraft cruises in the V-n diagram's caution band, not normal operation.

cases.name: cruise_in_the_caution_band
cases.why: the cruise point is past VC but short of VD: the diagram's yellow band, which is a warning and not a block

issues.message: H-stab tip chord (9.00 m) must be smaller than its root chord (8.00 m).
V-stab tip chord (10.00 m) must be smaller than its root chord (9.50 m).

cases.name: untapered_empennage
cases.why: both stabilisers wider at the tip than at the root: two errors from one rule, in the order the rule appends them

issues.message: H-stab tip chord (8.00 m) must be smaller than its root chord (8.00 m).

cases.name: tip_chord_equal_to_root
cases.why: an untapered surface is rejected as well as an inverted one, since the comparison is >= and not >

cases.name: both_rules_at_once
cases.why: two rules firing on one configuration, collected in registration order rather than the first one stopping the rest

cases.why: a real aircraft through the loading path: a preset that changes both the cruise point and the empennage must still pass
